MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The mounting magnets felt like a natural extension of my recent magnetic hooks because they could help me attach my own holders, provided the mounting surface works.",
    "The metric screw assortment matched the small-fastener sizes I recently bought, so it reflected a real interest even though I would pass on another overlapping kit right now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The solder connectors and ring terminals require particular wiring jobs; buying small screws and magnetic hooks does not mean I currently need electrical repair supplies.",
    "The grinding discs require a compatible grinder and a grinding task, neither of which my recent purchases establish.",
    "The gloves and COVID test did not connect to my current hardware interests, and the gloves also assume a size and quantity I have not shown I need.",
    "Epoxy putty might be useful someday, but I rarely choose supplies without a concrete use in mind."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in a few practical hardware items seemed to be stretched into an interest in almost any workshop or repair supply.",
    "My purchases of assortment kits seemed to be taken as a reason to offer more bulk assortments, regardless of whether they serve the same purpose or duplicate what I already have."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My two recent magnetic-hook purchases make mounting and hanging uses more relevant than unrelated wiring or grinding tasks.",
    "A recent fastener purchase can mean that need is already covered; a similar kit needs a distinct use before I would choose it.",
    "I need a clear practical fit, including suitable surfaces, dimensions, or equipment, before a related item becomes worth choosing."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in magnets and small fasteners, but stretched it into repair projects and supply needs I have not expressed."
}
